p.src: This posture also reduces the power of other people’s opinions. In the long term, most comments are temporary weather. Some criticism is useful and should be examined. Much is noise. As your skill improves, you naturally move away from the people who only know how to mock beginnings. They are not necessarily malicious. They are simply operating at the wrong time scale.

p.src: This is the practical bridge between learning and wealth freedom. Wealth freedom is not reached by one dramatic secret.
